view: Near overhead oblique view Harappa Mound F parallel low brick foundations and narrow passages, eroded mound edge, loose regular baked bricks foreground, no conjectural granary superstructure or towering city.

eras.title: Bricks beneath the mound
eras.caption: Harappa's excavated mounds revealed a Bronze Age city built largely of brick. Foundations, passages and surviving courses of masonry helped archaeologists recognise a civilisation shared with Mohenjo-daro and other Indus settlements.
